# coolify_vultr_plans (Data Source)

Lists Vultr plans for a cloud provider token. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Vultr cloud provider token to use for listing plans. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `disk` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `id` (String) Plan ID.
- `monthly_cost` (Number) Monthly cost USD.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in MB.
- `type` (String) Plan type.
- `vcpu_count` (Number) vCPU count.
